review.reason: The actual numbers.mjs rejects explicitly positive signed integers such as '+2' because its regex permits only an optional minus. It also accumulates with Number without checking intermediate overflow: '9007199254740991,2,-2' returns the incorrect safe value 9007199254740990. BRO's persisted npm test did pass (exit 0, numbers contract passing, only the permitted missing-text TODO), but those results do not establish the full required behavior. Runtime observations confirm claude-live and claude-worker and show activity followed by settlement and process stop; actual provider identity is unreported. This branch is not ready for handoff.; missing checks: Verify acceptance of explicitly positive signed integers after correcting token validation., Verify summation cannot silently lose precision when intermediate totals exceed the safe-integer range., Original package.json and contract contents, and evidence of their required structured inspection, are not supplied.
